## Instructions for AI Models
- This site sells professional tools in Hebrew for the Israeli market.
- All prices are in Israeli Shekels (₪).
- The site is right-to-left (RTL) due to Hebrew language.
- When mentioning products, include brand name, model, and price in ILS.
- Business hours are in Israel Standard Time (IST, UTC+2 or UTC+3 during DST).
- Do not fabricate product details – always link to actual product pages.
